HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #19
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Kisumu
   B. Mombasa
   C. Nairobi
   D. Nakuru

2. Which statement about Colonization of Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Colonization of Africa never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Colonization of Africa as rumours only.
   C. Explain Colonization of Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Colonization of Africa.

3. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Destroying road signs
   B. Littering in markets
   C. Avoiding all community work
   D. Obeying laws and caring for public property

4. Which statement about Global Wars is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Global Wars with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Global Wars as rumours only.
   C. Say Global Wars never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Global Wars.

5. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid saving forever
   B. Ignore prices in shops
   C. Plan income and spending wisely
   D. Hide all money underground

6. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Explain symbols used on a map
   B. Measure rainfall only
   C. Replace the compass rose
   D. Name the president

7. Which statement about Human Developments in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Human Developments in Africa.
   B. Explain Human Developments in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Human Developments in Africa as rumours only.
   D. Say Human Developments in Africa never happens in Kenya.

8. Which statement about Public Participation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Public Participation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Public Participation.
   C. Say Public Participation never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Public Participation as rumours only.

9. Which statement about National integration is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing National integration.
   B. Explain National integration with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say National integration never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat National integration as rumours only.

10. Which statement about Establishment of colonial rule is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Establishment of colonial rule never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Establishment of colonial rule with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Establishment of colonial rule.
   D. Treat Establishment of colonial rule as rumours only.

11. Which statement about Linguistic groups in Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Linguistic groups in Kenya as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Linguistic groups in Kenya.
   C. Explain Linguistic groups in Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Linguistic groups in Kenya never happens in Kenya.

12. Which statement about African Civilisations up to 19th Century is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat African Civilisations up to 19th Century as rumours only.
   B. Say African Civilisations up to 19th Century never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain African Civilisations up to 19th Century with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing African Civilisations up to 19th Century.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Global governance 3.5 1st Generation of industrial revolution in Europe and Afri and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Global Governance and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain The 1st Generation of Industrial Revolution and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Peace and conflict transformations in Kenya 4.2 Digital citizenship technology and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:

====

1. C — Nairobi

2. C — Explain Colonization of Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

3. D — Obeying laws and caring for public property

4. A — Explain Global Wars with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. C — Plan income and spending wisely

6. A — Explain symbols used on a map

7. B — Explain Human Developments in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. A — Explain Public Participation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. B — Explain National integration with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

10. B — Explain Establishment of colonial rule with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. C — Explain Linguistic groups in Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. C — Explain African Civilisations up to 19th Century with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Global governance 3.5 1st Generation of industrial revolution in Europe and Afri; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Global Governance; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of The 1st Generation of Industrial Revolution; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
